### 5️⃣ Notify 🔔 · Discord
**Suggested Response** adds a rule-based next-step hint, auto-boosted if AbuseIPDB confidence ≥ 50%, and truncates every field to Discord's embed limits (title 256 chars, field values 1024 chars) so a long AI response or raw log can't break the notification.

**Discord Notify** posts one embed: title, color by severity (🔴 ≥12, 🟠 ≥9, 🔵 below), fields for level/agent/source IP/reputation/AI summary/next step. Webhook URL read from `$env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` — never stored in this JSON.

Nothing here takes automated action — every alert is for human review.
